items.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Q2 Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group has seen its analyst fair value estimate move from $424.23 to $475.23, a shift of about 12% in the underlying price target framework. Recent research attributes this change to Q2 earnings, updates around Medicare Advantage and Optum Health, and refreshed 2026 earnings models. These are cited as key reasons many analysts are resetting their targets higher while still flagging risks around commercial trends, Medicaid, and ongoing regulatory scrutiny.
